metadata.bookend_exempt_reason: Assignment 8 sets the film's order (the game in brief, the GDD, the seven questions, the appendix) and says AI narration speaks as the student, without the instructor's name, persona or credit line. So the opening is the hesitant writer in my voice, there is no verdict card and no Your Turn, and the outro carries my name.

beats.act: GDD 4: core mechanics, with losing and restarting
beats.narration_text: A slash can't restart until it ends, a hit knocks the sword away before it costs a heart, and a fall returns Rudy to the last waystone. Block, staff and climbing are designed, not built.
